# Docs for the Azure Web Apps Deploy action: https://github.com/Azure/webapps-deploy
# More GitHub Actions for Azure: https://github.com/Azure/actions

name: Build and deploy container app to Azure Web App - maxfelker

# Fires when a version tag (e.g. v0.2) is pushed — created by a release/tag bump.
# Builds the image, pushes it to ACR as :<version> and :latest, then deploys :<version>.
on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

env:
  IMAGE: maxfelkershared.azurecr.io/${{ secrets.AzureAppService_ContainerUsername_7ccb2219d146486b8ba8d718ca245fc9 }}/maxfelkershared/maxfelker.com

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: 'ubuntu-latest'

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4

    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

    - name: Log in to registry
      uses: docker/login-action@v3
      with:
        registry: https://maxfelkershared.azurecr.io/
        username: ${{ secrets.AzureAppService_ContainerUsername_7ccb2219d146486b8ba8d718ca245fc9 }}
        password: ${{ secrets.AzureAppService_ContainerPassword_34399185984a471f93f581e62f525160 }}

    - name: Build and push container image to registry
      uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
      with:
        push: true
        tags: |
          ${{ env.IMAGE }}:${{ github.ref_name }}
          ${{ env.IMAGE }}:latest
        file: ./Dockerfile

  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    environment:
      name: 'production'
      url: ${{ steps.deploy-to-webapp.outputs.webapp-url }}

    steps:
    - name: Deploy to Azure Web App
      id: deploy-to-webapp
      uses: azure/webapps-deploy@v3
      with:
        app-name: 'maxfelker'
        slot-name: 'production'
        publish-profile: ${{ secrets.AzureAppService_PublishProfile_df9b10478edf480b92f2901a2198ebff }}
        images: '${{ env.IMAGE }}:${{ github.ref_name }}'

services:
  release:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: maxfelker.com/release:latest
    ports:
      - 80:80
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
  dev:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile.dev
    image: maxfelker.com/dev:latest
    ports:
      - 5173:5173
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: development
    volumes:
      - ./public:/app/public
      - ./src:/app/src
      - ./articles:/app/articles
      - ./index.html:/app/index.html
      - ./manifest.json:/app/manifest.json
      - ./package.json:/app/package.json
      - ./sitemap.xml:/app/sitemap.xml
      - ./vite.config.js:/app/vite.config.js

# Articles

Each article is a folder holding its Markdown and its images together. Vite reads them
at build time (`src/articles.js`) — no CMS, no build step beyond `npm run build`.

```
articles/
  your-article-slug/
    index.md
    hero.jpg
    figure.jpg
```

## Add an article

1. Create `articles/<slug>/index.md`. The folder name is the URL slug (`/article/<slug>`).
2. Start with frontmatter, then write the body in Markdown:

```markdown
---
title: Your article title
summary: One or two sentences used in previews and the home page list.
date: 2024-02-15
image: hero.jpg
---

Body goes here in **Markdown**.
```

## Frontmatter fields

| field     | required | notes                                                        |
|-----------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| `title`   | yes      | Article heading.                                             |
| `summary` | yes      | Short description for listings and link previews.            |
| `date`    | yes      | `YYYY-MM-DD`. Drives ordering — newest first.                |
| `slug`    | no       | URL is `/article/<slug>`. Defaults to the folder name.       |
| `image`   | no       | Hero image. Shown at the top of the article AND used as the link-preview (OG/Twitter) image. |

The article appears in the list and at `/article/<slug>` after a rebuild. That's it.

## Images

Drop image files into the article's own folder, next to `index.md`, and reference them
by **bare filename** — they're resolved to `/articles/<slug>/<file>` automatically:

- **Hero / preview image:** set `image: hero.jpg` in the frontmatter. Use ~1200×630 for
  the best social-card crop.
- **Inline images:** standard Markdown in the body — `![alt text](figure.jpg)`. They scale
  to the column width automatically.

(Absolute paths and full `https://` URLs are left as-is if you'd rather host elsewhere.)

# Build stage
FROM node:22-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# Production stage
FROM nginx:1.27-alpine
COPY --from=build /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
# CMD chmod -R 755 /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY default.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
EXPOSE 80
ENTRYPOINT nginx -g 'daemon off;'

FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY public ./public
COPY src/ ./src
COPY articles ./articles
COPY index.html ./
COPY manifest.json ./
COPY sitemap.xml ./
COPY vite.config.js ./
COPY package.json ./
RUN npm i
ENTRYPOINT npm run dev
